svg.text: Flow 3 — Roster and editor: the University opens straight into the editor
Today's profile dialog, moved into the University and flattened: roster grouped by college on the left, one-page editor on the right. Rooms keep hiring.
Attach a skill or MCP server:
The building or sign opens the editor on the last profile.
Same entries elsewhere: Settings, Actions, Board.
Pick a profile; its whole profile is one page.
Skills and MCP from this college, ticked in place.
Opens that college's page in the right pane.
As today: a room's + seat or New agent, then the profile card.
Either way the hire walks out of the University gate.
On a phone: the roster is the sheet; a profile opens its one-column page with Back at the top.
Phone taps: hire 2 (Hire on the row),
Least new UI: today's dialog without
its five tabs, moved into the
University. Hiring stays where it is
Cost: the editor is the first thing
you see, even when you only hire.
numbered marks = the clicks or taps, in order; the University art is a marked placeholder (Town's art direction is undecided, #1117)
